issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other: Water 26,303 + Sewer 26,439 + Garbage 15,363
issues.issue: These are the only receipts of the Water, Sewer and Garbage funds, so they are almost certainly utility charges (Utility Charges). The printed label says Other, so leaving them in other can be defended. Business-type receipts are 100% other.

A large unexplained receipt: about 37% of governmental receipts. It is close to the General Fund's Community Development spending of 118,853, so it may be a grant or pass-through. It is in other, and the page gives no breakdown.

Under the user's 2026-11-04 rule, Community Betterment spending, including lines printed 'Community development/betterment', is its own category (Community Betterment). This line reads only 'Community Development', so the rule may or may not apply.
The county treasurer balance is printed below the statement, outside the cash totals, and is not in the balance sheet (only mentioned in notes).
